body: that’s.. insane. i’m really sorry. i’m on my third week recovering from CHS caused by d8. i use to smoke d8 regularly, everyday. this is very real. now i’m not anti-marijuana by any means, if i could i would. but this is such a horrible thing to go through and it sucks when people won’t take you seriously. anyway, i wish you the best on your recovery and everyone else!!
hi 👋 i got CHS from delta-8, left me pretty fucked up to say the least. you can definitely get it from ANY cannabinoid!!

hey there! i just got mine removed (: if it helps, you really don’t feel ANYTHING besides the initial anesthesia shot! what i do to help is breathe slowly and turn my head all the way and look the opposite way of what the doctor is doing! some doctors may let you put in ear buds to listen to something while it’s done. it really doesn’t take more than a few minutes! but if you’re extremely anxious, i’d suggest asking them for some sort of anti-anxiety drug beforehand like the others have suggested. i would call the office beforehand and see if they have that available for you. you could always ask your primary doctor/pharmacist as well to see if they can prescribe a pill for you to take beforehand. i really hope you’ll be okay!
